comments.text:
Correction - RTX 4090 MSRP is $1600, not $1500 as I state in the video. This makes it 33% more expensive than the 4080, but 36% faster (pure rasterization).
Realistically that's still a worthwhile margin to consider and shows that the 4080 should be far cheaper.
